panels.description: Saved minus added over the selected range, cache effects included: a keep-alive rescue is saved, a cache break is added. This is the number that says whether the proxy pays. Beside it, the net as a share of the baseline: what the traffic would have cost without the proxy, which is spend (actual plus estimated) plus net saved. The exact baseline counter (llm_savings_baseline_usd_total) is not built yet.

panels.title: Net saved by source
panels.description: Where NET SAVED comes from, as context-guru's dashboard splits it. Context rewrite: every operator that rewrites the request (its content, its tool declarations, its model), net of its own model calls and of the cache breaks the changes cause. Cache management: the keep-alive (its rescues, net of its pings), the prefix-cache split, the 1h head TTL and the breakpoints the proxy adds. Of baseline: each net as a share of what the traffic would have cost without the proxy (spend plus net saved); the two sources add up to the Total. For proxy="context-guru", the split is right only for builds with rossoctl/context-guru#1362: an older build pushes the keep-alive, head-TTL and breakpoint operators as component="other", which counts under Context rewrite. The Total is right for every build.
